description: How readily the clan gives ground. The first thing a culture learns and the last thing it unlearns.
Meeting a threat rather than leaving. Cheap when it works and catastrophic when it does not.
Stopping while there is still something worth doing. Harder to learn than it sounds.
Eating. The one drive the authored floor will always override upward.
Going to look. Every discovery the clan ever makes is paid for out of this drive.
Holding still and watching. Reads as doing nothing and is frequently the correct answer.
Standing between the herd and the dark. What the Guardian archetype is made of.
Seeking company for its own sake. The substrate every transmitted behaviour travels along.
Gathering for the clan rather than the self. Distinct from eating, and a much later thing to learn.
Leaving. Correct exactly often enough that a clan cannot afford to lose it.
Practising at no stake. Pure cost in the short run, which is why only a secure clan keeps it.
Reaching for an object instead of a limb. The drive the whole design exists to watch spread.
